//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the SELECT component — the dropdown form field `.pa-select` (keen `PureAdmin.Components.Form.select/1`, svelte `forms/Select.svelte`). SCOPE = the `<select class="pa-select ...">` CONTAINER + its class/native-attr contract. Like pa-input, pa-select owns the full validation set: size (xs/sm/lg/xl), state (success/warning/error), themeColor (color-1..9) — all confirmed in dist/css/main.css. OPTIONS ARE OUT OF SCOPE: the two wrappers build option children through DIFFERENT, non-slot APIs — keen from an `options` list (default []) + an optional `prompt` via `Phoenix.HTML.Form.options_for_select`, svelte from a `children` snippet of raw <option> markup. There is no shared neutral representation for option rows, so every scenario renders the EMPTY select (no options, no prompt) and the fixture proves only the <select> tag + its pa-select class (+ size/state/color modifiers) + native attrs. disabled/required/multiple are NATIVE attrs, not classes (no pa-select--disabled). `value` selects an option and is meaningless with zero options, so it is not modeled. svelte additionally has `multiple` (a static-attribute branch) — exercised as a native boolean here. keen select/1 appends a conditional `<.form_help variant="error">` only when :field errors are present; no scenario feeds a field, so both wrappers emit a bare <select>. Sibling pa-input/pa-textarea + the field-wrapper chrome are separate components, prose-deferred. See input.json for the bare-control model.

propsVocabulary.size: xs|sm|lg|xl — height/padding/font size variant (default is the unmodified md select). Shared scale with pa-input/pa-textarea; emits pa-select--{size}.
propsVocabulary.state: success|warning|error — validation border (pa-select--{state}). Core defines all three for pa-select (same set as pa-input).
propsVocabulary.themeColor: 1..9 theme colour slot — pa-select--color-N (paints the border with --pc-color-N). Orthogonal to state/size.
propsVocabulary.name: native name attribute
propsVocabulary.id: native id attribute (hand-set — the normalizer keeps real ids)
propsVocabulary.disabled: native boolean attribute (there is NO pa-select--disabled class)
propsVocabulary.multiple: native boolean attribute — renders a multi-select list (svelte branches on it; keen passes it via @rest)
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Goldens encode the EMPTY `<select class="pa-select ..."></select>` — no option children (options are the out-of-scope, API-divergent sub-slice; see top note). A state modifier is present when a state is set, a size modifier when a size is set, pa-select--color-N when themeColor is set. Native boolean attrs (disabled/required/multiple) are canonicalized to bare presence by the normalizer. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (the `.pa-select--*` set is exactly: xs/sm/lg/xl, success/warning/error, color-1..9 — no pa-select__* elements exist). `produces: null` = a native HTML attr (name/id) or native boolean attr (disabled/required/multiple), NOT a pa-select modifier.

disabled.note: native boolean attribute — there is NO pa-select--disabled class

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

deferred.//: No `pa-select__*` element classes exist in main.css. The <option> rows are a sub-slice intentionally left out (the two wrappers build them via different non-slot APIs — keen `options` list + `prompt`, svelte `children` snippet of raw <option>s — so there is no shared neutral representation). They carry no pa-select class and don't affect the axis-1 element sweep; recorded for reviewer orientation.
deferred.note-options: Option children — keen: `options` list ({value,label} tuples/strings) + optional `prompt` via options_for_select; svelte: `children` snippet of raw <option> markup. API-divergent, no shared golden; the empty select is modeled instead.
deferred.note-form-group: pa-form-group / --success|warning|error|horizontal|required — the field WRAPPER (form-layout component). Modeled by the form-group slice.
deferred.note-form-help: pa-form-help / --error|success|warning|color-N — help/validation caption. Modeled by the form-help slice.

scenarios.name: basic
scenarios.note: The blessed default container: an empty <select class="pa-select">. Both wrappers emit a bare <select> with no options.

scenarios.name: state-error
scenarios.note: The error state also emits aria-invalid="true" (a11y contract — pairs with pa-select--error).

scenarios.name: disabled
scenarios.note: native disabled attr — no pa-select--disabled class. Normalizer canonicalizes to bare presence.

scenarios.name: multiple
scenarios.note: native multiple attr — svelte branches on it (static attr alongside bind:value), keen passes it via @rest.

scenarios.name: name-id
scenarios.note: name + id are hand-set; the normalizer keeps real (non-generated) ids.

scenarios.name: extra-class
scenarios.note: Class passthrough — the extra class is appended after pa-select.

scenarios.name: combined
scenarios.golden: <select name="role" id="role" required aria-invalid="true" class="pa-select pa-select--sm pa-select--error pa-select--color-3"></select>
scenarios.note: Stacks size + state + themeColor + native attrs to exercise class ordering + attribute passthrough together; the error state carries aria-invalid="true".
